subject: Reconciling management-channel drift after blue-green agent rollout — remediation plan
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@novamed.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Torres <mike.torres@novamed.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Oct 2028 20:14:00 -0700
Subject: Intermittent private control channel 503s after agent upgrade

Hi Olga,

We rolled your 2028-10-11 blue/green agent update across our US VPC yesterday (staged canary -> all). Since early this morning we've seen intermittent 503 responses from the private control channel and short-lived session drops on about 5% of inference calls. We've pinned the data plane to the old model version, but the management channel still shows repeated reconnects in the last 3 hours.

Attached are the connection traces and our agent rollout manifest. Can you confirm whether Redwood pushed any additional orchestration changes that might coincide with this? We need a remediation path and SOC2-friendly evidence for our audit team.

Thanks,
Sanjay
Sanjay Patel
CTO, Novamed.ai

Attachments: novamed-conntrace-20281011.txt, agent-rollout-manifest-20281011.yml
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@novamed.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Oct 2028 21:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent private control channel 503s after agent upgrade

Thanks for the quick alert, Sanjay — I'm looking at the traces now. We did a coordinated agent rollout (blue->green) for the management-sidecar at 03:40 UTC; there was no other orchestration change in your region at that time.

Immediate next steps I recommend now that we've confirmed the pattern:
- Pin your edge sidecars to the previous agent version (you mentioned this is done) and confirm no further session key rotations occur.
- Change the heartbeat TTL to 18s (from default 10s) as a temporary mitigation to avoid transient disconnects while we diagnose.
- Schedule a 30-minute bridge with our infra team so we can walk the logs and, if needed, perform a targeted rollback.

Can you provide a window for a bridge in the next hour? I'll loop in Marcus and Aditya to coordinate the rollback/runbook steps and ensure we capture the full evidentiary snapshot for SOC2.

Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0193

Subject: Re: Intermittent private control channel 503s after agent upgrade

Quick diagnostic notes from our side after an initial pass over the artifacts:
- Root cause (preliminary): mismatch during the blue->green switch that left a subset (~5%) of control-plane sessions using a deprecated session key rotation routine. That routine expires sessions slightly earlier than expected under certain network rehandshake latencies.
- Triggers: elevated connection churn during the canary window + an edge timing assumption change introduced in agent v3.14.2.

Remediation plan (short):
1) Immediate: roll back the management-sidecar to v3.14.1 for the affected pool (scheduled immediately on approval). This is the fastest way to stop new session mismatches.
2) Mid-term: deploy a hotfix to v3.14.3 that ensures backward-compatible session key rotation and adds a guard to tolerate 2x rehandshake latency.
3) Evidence collection: create an artifacts bundle (conn traces, agent metrics, orchestrator logs) and store to a shared folder for Novamed's auditors.

I'll prepare the rollback recipe and a playbook for coordinated execution with your ops team. Estimated timeline to cutover rollback and validate: 45-90 minutes once we have bridge approval.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

Sanjay

Subject: Re: Intermittent private control channel 503s after agent upgrade — post-rollback summary and evidence

Hi Sanjay,

Bridge recap and actions taken (summary):
- 03:10 UTC 2028-10-12: executed coordinated rollback of management-sidecar from v3.14.2 -> v3.14.1 for the affected us-west-2 pool.
- 03:55 UTC: verified stabilization of control channel; session error rate dropped from ~5% -> <0.2% over 30m.
- Collected evidence bundle: conn traces, orchestrator logs, heartbeat metrics, and session key rotation entries. Bundle stored at: https://drive.redwood/reports/novamed/2028-10-12-management-channel-evidence (read-only link).

Compliance notes for your auditors:
- The session-key rotation entries include monotonic identifiers and timestamps; we appended a signed checksum file to the bundle to provide tamper-evidence.
- We'll retain the evidence bundle for 180 days by default; if you need longer retention, please advise and we'll provision an extended retention artifact.

Follow-up / next steps for Redwood (internal):
- Marcus to produce v3.14.3 hotfix with back-compat guard and run safety-canary across a small test subset.
- Aditya to update rollout orchestration to include a gating check on session-key backwards compatibility.
- Hannah to prepare an internal postmortem and customer-facing one-pager for your CISO team.

Sanjay, please confirm if the evidence bundle and retention window meet your audit needs or if you'd like the bundle sent via SFTP for additional chain-of-custody controls.

Thanks — glad we got this stabilized quickly. We'll follow up with the detailed postmortem and hotfix ETA within 48 hours.

Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
